source_behavior_preserved: Area center-span mode retains signed span; two-point mode uses midpoint and absolute half extent.
Statistic array_append spreads only one array level before scalar reduction.
Seconds format replaces only the first occurrence of each token and appends fractional hundredths independently of the format.
Negative seconds use floor-based day/hour/minute decomposition.

Differential stores previous value and signed fractional frame independently per processor row. Same-frame samples return zero but replace the previous value, and rewinds produce signed frame differences.
Boolean Trigger retains prior Boolean and emitted trigger across condition changes; unsupported conditions preserve the previous trigger while replacing the prior Boolean.
native_logic_array_policy: The inspected evalLogicArray refers to undefined cl in max(al,bl,cl), despite only a and b parameters. Native looping uses max(al,bl), repeats shorter array rows, and treats empty row access as false. Scalar logic follows the pinned source; array looping is an explicit native correction pending desktop evidence.

number_format_runtime.behavior: HTML5 string_format delegates to Number.toFixed. Native conversion corrects exact binary decimal ties to magnitude-away rounding, preserves negative-zero spelling and uses source padding/insertion order. Desktop runtime formatting equivalence remains unverified.

buffer_base64_native_policy: Native Base64 uses unsigned byte shifts, avoiding undefined signed-char high-byte shifts in the pinned embedded C++ extension. ASCII preserves bytes through the first zero terminator; binary is MSB-first and hex uppercase.

file_path_runtime.behavior: filename_ext uses substr(lastIndexOf(dot)); a name without a dot returns its final UTF-16 unit. Source filename_name_only replaces the first extension occurrence. Native preserves BMP behavior and refuses extensionless astral final units whose isolated surrogate cannot be represented in valid UTF-8. Desktop equivalence remains unverified.
